prose.text: Shift leads need a daily report showing short picks per picker to target retraining, since right now they mostly guess.
Sam builds the report by hand in Excel from a WMS export every Monday, which takes about four hours; the WMS dashboard only shows building totals.
Automate a daily report per picker showing short picks, using WMS pick confirmations, ready by 6am for shift leads.
No customer or pricing data; cancelled lines and over picks are not included.
If the new report disagrees with WMS pick confirmations for two weeks, Sam will switch back to the spreadsheet.

acceptance.given: The WMS reporting copy is available and contains pick confirmations.
acceptance.when: The report is generated by 6am and matches WMS numbers for short picks per picker.
acceptance.then: Shift leads use the report to select pickers for retraining.

acceptance.given: The report numbers for short picks per picker do not match WMS pick confirmations for two consecutive weeks.
acceptance.when: Sam reviews the numbers and finds discrepancies.
acceptance.then: Sam switches off the new report and returns to the manual spreadsheet process.

guardrails.text: If the numbers in the new report disagreed with the WMS two weeks in a row Sam would switch it off and go back to the spreadsheet.

open_questions.question: Should wrong-location scans always count as short picks, or are there exceptions?
open_questions.artifact_needed: Written rule or confirmation from Priya

open_questions.question: Should the report be ready by 6am or 7am, and who needs it first?

reflect_back_text: You need a daily report showing short picks per picker so shift leads can target retraining.
